task_summary: Customer requests warranty assistance for a faulty FlexCharge Travel Dock purchased under order ORD-6032. The correct process is to verify warranty coverage, review the warranty policy, provide a preview, obtain confirmation, and proceed with filing a claim as per policy. Since the warranty expired more than 30 days ago, the policy permits either a paid repair at full price or a 25% discount on a replacement, not a free warranty claim.
